text:
Type: brown tinted glass vase
Use: holding branches or a few stems on a table, sideboard or shelf; living room, dining room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, mid-century modern
Materials: tinted blown glass with a slightly irregular hand-formed look
Colors: warm smoky taupe brown, translucent
Shape: organic teardrop form, a bulbous uneven bottom tapering to a narrow neck and a tilted flared mouth, asymmetric and sculptural
Feel: organic, warm, artful, calm
Goes with: dried branches, walnut or oak, cream or beige tones; Scandinavian, mid-century or Japandi rooms

product.name: VRVIND
product.description: Use the vase with flowers or alone, as a beautiful object in its own right.
